**Finding: Deviation (rule LD — Liquidated damages payable by Customer)**

Section 4.2(a) (¶p0026) requires the Company to pay HDI a termination payment equal to 50% of the preceding twelve months' Net Sales above $800,000 whenever the Company terminates. Because our fees under Section 3.1 are only 30% of Net Sales above $11,000/month, and the term is one year terminable on 90 days' notice, this liquidated amount can materially exceed both three months' fees and the remaining contract value — and it bites even if we terminate for HDI's own breach. That fails the fallback and edges into walk-away territory.

Redline (validated, fallback level): cap the Termination Payment at three months' Section 3.1 fees, make it the sole amount payable on termination, and carve out termination arising from HDI's breach. The instalment mechanic in 4.2(c) is left intact.
